targets.query:
from(bucket: "solar_raw")
  |> range(start: -5m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "solar" and r._field == "value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.device == "${device}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => (r.component == "pv1" or r.component == "pv2") and r.metric == "power")
  |> last()
  |> group()
  |> sum(column: "_value")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _field: "PV" }))

panels.title: LOAD Port
panels.description: Backup / essential port only — not whole-house load

targets.query:
from(bucket: "solar_raw")
  |> range(start: -5m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "solar" and r._field == "value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.device == "${device}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.component == "load" and r.metric == "power")

from(bucket: "solar_raw")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "solar" and r._field == "value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.device == "${device}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) =>
      (r.component == "pv1" and r.metric == "power") or
      (r.component == "pv2" and r.metric == "power") or
      (r.component == "battery" and r.metric == "power") or
      (r.component == "grid" and r.metric == "power_ct") or
      (r.component == "load" and r.metric == "power") or
      (r.component == "house" and r.metric == "power") or
      (r.component == "inverter" and r.metric == "power")
  )
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
      r with _field:
        if r.component == "grid" then "grid"
        else if r.component == "house" then "house"
        else r.component
  }))
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "mean")

from(bucket: "solar_raw")
  |> range(start: today())
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "solar" and r._field == "value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.device == "${device}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) =>
      r.metric == "energy_today" or
      r.metric == "buy_today" or
      r.metric == "sell_today" or
      r.metric == "charge_today" or
      r.metric == "discharge_today"
  )
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
      r with _field:
        if r.component == "house" then "House"
        else if r.component == "pv" then "PV"
        else if r.component == "load" then "LOAD port"
        else if r.metric == "buy_today" then "Buy"
        else if r.metric == "sell_today" then "Sell"
        else if r.metric == "charge_today" then "Charge"
        else if r.metric == "discharge_today" then "Discharge"
        else r.component
  }))

panels.title: Mean power by hour (today)
panels.description: Hourly mean watts — one stacked column per hour

targets.query:
from(bucket: "solar_raw")
  |> range(start: today())
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "solar" and r._field == "value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.device == "${device}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) =>
      (r.component == "pv1" and r.metric == "power") or
      (r.component == "pv2" and r.metric == "power") or
      (r.component == "house" and r.metric == "power") or
      (r.component == "grid" and r.metric == "power_ct") or
      (r.component == "battery" and r.metric == "power")
  )
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
      r with
        _field:
          if r.component == "grid" then "grid"
          else if r.component == "house" then "house"
          else r.component,
        _value:
          if r.component == "house" then -r._value
          else r._value
  }))
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1h, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "mean")

  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "solar" and r._field == "value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.device == "${device}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) =>
      (r.component == "pv" and r.metric == "energy_today") or
      (r.component == "house" and r.metric == "energy_today") or
      (r.component == "grid" and r.metric == "buy_today") or
      (r.component == "grid" and r.metric == "sell_today") or
      (r.component == "battery" and r.metric == "charge_today") or
      (r.component == "battery" and r.metric == "discharge_today")
  )
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
      r with
        _field:
          if r.component == "house" then "House"
          else if r.component == "pv" then "PV"
          else if r.metric == "buy_today" then "Buy"
          else if r.metric == "sell_today" then "Sell"
          else if r.metric == "charge_today" then "Charge"
          else if r.metric == "discharge_today" then "Discharge"
          else r.component,
        _value:
          if r.component == "house" then -r._value
          else if r.metric == "charge_today" then -r._value
          else if r.metric == "sell_today" then -r._value
          else r._value
  }))
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1d, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "daily")
